RSI at 48.7 is consolidating in neutral territory, and the MACD histogram's improvement (-3.5878 to -0.7662) is positive. analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($377.67) vs SMA5/20/50 ($387.19/$385.84/$375.21) - Trading below short/mid-term trends, above mid-term SMA50.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($366.58/$382.47) - Mid-to-long-term trend shows slight bearish bias.
· 52-week position (39.9%) + Current price level approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.9→48.7) + Neutral range consolidation continues, slight increase in downward pressure.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.5878→-0.7662) + Improvement diagnosed, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $385.84) + Bandwidth narrowing to 16.66% interpreted as consolidation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($373.04) + Based on moving averages.
· Swing resistance ($384.04) + Breakout could lead to short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low > 20-day low, 5-day high < 20-day high) consolidation pattern + Trend reversal uncertainty.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.27x) + Low confidence in current price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Entry/wait conditions: Consider buying on a break above $384.04, consider selling on a break below $373.04.
